title: Starmer Gives Defiance Speech Fighting for Political Survival; UK Gilt Yields Rise
detail: Prime Minister Keir Starmer delivered a pivotal address on 11 May 2026 in which he pledged to remain as Prime Minister and fight for his political survival, framing the speech as a commitment to the government's long-term reform agenda rather than short-term political popularity. Starmer acknowledged voter anger over the cost of living and the pace of change, but argued that the alternative — abandoning the programme mid-term — would represent a greater betrayal of the public. Markets reacted to the political uncertainty: UK gilt yields rose during the week, with 10-year Gilts pushing higher as investors assessed the risk of political instability in a country already carrying near-100% debt-to-GDP. CNBC reported Starmer was 'fighting for his political future' as the speech was watched closely both domestically and by international financial markets for signs of fiscal commitment.

media.caption: Starmer fights for political future in pivotal speech as gilt yields rise amid UK instability
